editorial.blurb: Acapulco Cocina & Bar serves some of the most authentic and delicious Mexican food in the area, with standout carne asada that keeps guests coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Come during happy hour for exceptional value—reviewers scored two meals, an appetizer, four margaritas, and a beer for $75—and don't skip the quirky tequila shots offered by the owner at the bar.

topDishes.note: Tender, flavorful, and described as 'next level good'
